title: Dog tags and wags: Soldiers decontaminate search and rescue volunteers near North Complex Fire
description:
The Cal Guard's Lathrop-based 149th Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Nuclear (CBRN) Company sets up a decontamination site for search and rescue volunteers combing through the North Complex Fire footprint in Butte County, California.

(Video captured and edited by U.S. Air National Guard A1C Hannah L. Kirshman and Staff Sgt. Stefany M. Leyva)
